$comment: Recent Arrivals — a SYNTHETIC, hand-written set of new products for the home page's hanging-rail section (ADR 0017). Names, descriptions, sizes and the EVORA house brand are invented; each product is written to match its photo. Photos are Unsplash photos under the Unsplash License, credited per item; `cutout` files are the same photos with the background removed by scripts/catalog-import/cutouts/make_cutouts.py. Prices and stock are synthetic. List order is arrival order: the first is the newest.

products.name: Utility Nylon Bomber
products.description: A lightweight bomber in matte black nylon with a ribbed stand collar, cuffs and hem, a two-way front zip and welt hand pockets.

photo.alt: Black nylon bomber jacket with a ribbed collar on a hanger against a beige wall

products.name: Rust Flight Bomber
products.description: The classic flight bomber in a soft rust shell: baseball collar, zipped utility pocket on the sleeve, slanted hand pockets and gathered ribbed cuffs and hem.

photo.alt: Rust-coloured bomber jacket with a sleeve pocket held up on a white hanger

products.name: Cord-Collar Denim Jacket
products.description: A trucker jacket in raw indigo denim with contrast topstitching, flap chest pockets, a pleated front and a tan corduroy collar.

photo.alt: Raw indigo denim trucker jacket with a tan corduroy collar on a hanger

products.name: Shawl-Collar Midnight Blazer
products.description: A one-button evening blazer in textured midnight navy with black satin shawl lapels, jetted pockets and a paisley lining.

photo.alt: Midnight-navy blazer with black satin shawl lapels and a pocket square on a hanger

products.name: Boiled Wool Funnel Coat
products.description: A mid-length coat in dense boiled wool with a funnel neck, a concealed zip, curved seam pockets and dropped shoulders.

photo.alt: Mustard boiled-wool coat with a funnel collar and seam pockets on a hanger

products.name: Felted Wool Chore Jacket
products.description: A boxy chore jacket in felted brown wool with a blue lining, an asymmetric front and a single patch pocket. Gets better with every wear.

photo.alt: Brown felted wool jacket with a blue lining hanging against dark wooden boards

products.name: Workwear Twill Overshirt
products.description: A heavy cotton-twill overshirt in royal blue with two flap chest pockets, a long back hem and a printed patch on the front.

photo.alt: Royal-blue twill work overshirt with chest pockets and a printed patch on a clothes rail

products.name: Hooded Canvas Parka
products.description: A cotton-canvas parka with a fleece-lined drawcord hood, a storm placket over the zip, a chest zip pocket and angled flap pockets.

photo.alt: Orange cotton-canvas parka with a fleece-lined hood
